pr_title: config, session: make Local Transaction not to affect Stale Read
pr_body:
Signed-off-by: JmPotato <ghzpotato@gmail.com>

### What problem does this PR solve?

Close #25479.

Decouple Stale Read and Local Txn by adding a new system variable named `EnableLocalTxn`. Should merge after #25525.

### What is changed and how it works?

Because both Stale Read and Local Txn need the `zone` label to determine their behavior, however, the latter is not released yet, to make sure they will not bother each other. I add a system variable `EnableLocalTxn` to disable Local Txn.

### Related changes

- tikv/client-go#93

### Check List <!--REMOVE the items that are not applicable-->

Tests <!-- At least one of them must be included. -->

- Unit test
- Integration test

### Release note <!-- bugfixes or new feature need a release note -->

- `No release note`.

issue_context.title: Refine the behavior of `@@txn_scope` value and Local Txn
issue_context.body:
## Feature Request

Now, if we configure the `zone` label for a TiDB instance, then the default value of `@@txn_scope` will be "local", which is not quite reasonable. Because:

* User may only want to use the zone label to make sure the stale read could read the nearest data without enabling the Local TSO feature for the PD.
* Labeling a TiDB instance with a zone label without configuring the PD to enable Local TSO will get a PD timeout error because `@@txn_scope` is "local" by default, which is confusing.

So I suggest setting the default value of `@@txn_scope` to "global".
comments: @JmPotato I think the main reason is that `@@txn_scope` at the session level. It is unreasonable to set the `@@txn_scope` for each connection in the application if the local transaction is used, so we directly use local in default if exists label configuration in TiDB. At that time, only local transactions could be used with label configuration. I think maybe we need a global variable to control the default value of local/global transaction's txn scope. cc @Yisaer

review_comments: There should be error after setting `txn_scope` as `local` while the label `zone` value is empty.

Because now `@@txn_scope` is decoupled with label, we will set it without checking the label content. On the other hand, `GetTxnScopeFromConfig()` won't return empty label according to [here](https://github.com/tikv/client-go/pull/93/files#diff-fe44f09c4d5977b5f5eaea29170b6a0748819c9d02271746a20d81a5f3efca17R155).
I don't think `@@txn_scope` is `local` while the `CheckAndGetTxnScope` returns `global` is a good implementation and I still insist it.
